2607.29266.title: OsteoCAD: A Human-in-the-Loop Cloud-Edge Framework for Bone Tumor Segmentation
2607.29266.paper_summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Deep Learning (DL) have notably advanced medical image analysis, yet many health- care organizations struggle to adopt them due to limited com- putational resources and specialized expertise. To address these barriers, we introduce OsteoCAD, a modular eHealth framework that democratizes access to DL tools in clinical practice. Osteo- CAD delivers end-to-end DL capabilities-from dataset creation and preprocessing to model training and inference-through an integrated and user-friendly interface. To mitigate local hardware constraints, the framework securely connects to remote GPU infrastructures. We validate OsteoCAD's feasibility through a real-world case study in Mexico focused on large bone tumor segmentation. The results demonstrate the framework's ability to enable DL-powered eHealth solutions without demanding ad- vanced technical expertise or complex local configurations.
2607.29266.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧 (AI) 和深度學習 (DL) 在醫學影像分析方面有顯著的進展，然而許多醫療機構因為計算資源有限和專業知識不足而難以採用這些技術。為了解決這些障礙，我們推出了OsteoCAD，一個模組化的電子健康框架，旨在使臨床實踐中對DL工具的訪問變得更為平易近人。OsteoCAD提供端到端的DL功能——從數據集創建和預處理到模型訓練和推斷——通過一個集成且用戶友好的介面實現。為了減輕本地硬體的限制，該框架安全地連接到遠端GPU基礎設施。我們通過在墨西哥的一個實際案例研究來驗證OsteoCAD的可行性，該研究專注於大型骨腫瘤的分割。結果顯示該框架能夠實現DL驅動的電子健康解決方案，而不需要高級技術專業知識或複雜的本地配置。
